$sources: TBDY 2018 3.1, Tablo 3.1 (building importance classes BKS 1-3 and the importance factor I)
source: TBDY 2018 Tablo 3.1: BKS 1 (I = 1.5), BKS 2 (I = 1.2), BKS 3 (I = 1.0). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots: I and II take BKS 3, III BKS 2, IV BKS 1. TS 498 has no importance factor on the wind (1.0).

I.description: BKS 3: other buildings of low occupancy (I = 1.0)

II.description: BKS 3: residences, offices, hotels and the other buildings not in BKS 1 or 2 (I = 1.0)

III.description: BKS 2: buildings with many people for short periods (shopping centres, sports halls, cinemas, theatres, concert halls, places of worship) (I = 1.2)

IV.description: BKS 1: buildings to be used right after an earthquake (hospitals, schools, fire and emergency buildings, power and telecommunication buildings) and buildings with hazardous contents (I = 1.5)
